question: Cuanto fueron las ventas por anio, producto, categoria y cliente
query:
SELECT d.year AS "Año", cat.categoryname AS "Categoria", p.productname AS "Producto", c.companyname AS "Cliente", SUM(salesamount) AS "Ventas"
FROM sales s
JOIN date d ON s.orderdatekey = d.datekey
JOIN customer c ON s.customerkey = c.customerkey
JOIN product p ON s.productkey = p.productkey
JOIN category cat ON p.categorykey = cat.categorykey
GROUP BY d.year, cat.categoryname, p.productname, c.companyname
ORDER BY d.year, cat.categoryname, p.productname, c.companyname
evidence: GROUP BY d.year, cat.categoryname, p.productname, c.companyname

question: Cuanto fuero las ventas anuales por pais del cliente y del proveedor
query:
SELECT d.year AS "Año", ct.countryname AS "País del cliente", ct2.countryname AS "País del proveedor", SUM(s.salesamount) AS "Ventas"
FROM sales s
JOIN date d ON s.orderdatekey = d.datekey
JOIN customer c ON s.customerkey = c.customerkey
JOIN city cy ON cy.citykey = c.citykey
JOIN state st ON st.statekey = cy.statekey
JOIN country ct ON ct.countrykey = st.countrykey
JOIN supplier sp ON sp.supplierkey = s.supplierkey
JOIN city cy2 ON cy2.citykey = sp.citykey
JOIN state st2 ON st2.statekey = cy2.statekey
JOIN country ct2 ON ct2.countrykey = st2.countrykey
GROUP BY d.year, ct.countryname, ct2.countryname
ORDER BY d.year, ct.countryname, ct2.countryname

question: Cuanto fueron las ventas mensuales por pais de consumidor comparada con la del mes anterior
query:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
SELECT d.year, d.monthnumber, ct.countryname, SUM(salesamount) as salesamount
FROM sales s
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
JOIN customer c on c.customerkey = s.customerkey
JOIN city cy ON cy.citykey = c.citykey
JOIN state st ON st.statekey = cy.statekey
JOIN country ct ON ct.countrykey = st.countrykey
GROUP BY d.year, d.monthnumber, ct.countryname
)
SELECT year AS "Año", monthnumber AS "Mes", countryname AS "País", salesamount AS "Ventas",
LAG(salesamount) OVER(PARTITION BY countryname ORDER BY year,monthnumber) AS "Ventas del mes anterior"
FROM monthly_sales
evidence: OVER(PARTITION BY countryname ORDER BY year,monthnumber)

question: Cuanto fue el crecimiento mensual de ventas por producto?. Es decir, la ventas por mes de cada producto respecto a las del mes anterior
query:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
SELECT d.year, d.monthnumber, p.productname, SUM(salesamount) as salesamount
FROM sales s
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
JOIN product p ON p.productkey = s.productkey
GROUP BY d.year, d.monthnumber, p.productname
)
SELECT year AS "Año", monthnumber AS "Mes", productname AS "Producto", salesamount AS "Ventas",
LAG(salesamount) OVER(PARTITION BY productname ORDER BY year,monthnumber) AS "Ventas del mes anterior"
FROM monthly_sales
evidence: OVER(PARTITION BY productname ORDER BY year,monthnumber)

question: Dame los 3 empleados que mas ventas consiguieron
query:
SELECT lastname || ' ' || firstname AS "Empleado", SUM(salesamount) as "Ventas"
FROM sales s
JOIN employee e ON e.employeekey = s.employeekey
GROUP BY lastname,firstname
ORDER BY SUM(salesamount) DESC
LIMIT 3

question: Cuales fueron los empleados que mas ventas consiguieron por producto y en cada año
query:
WITH ranking AS (
SELECT d.year, p.productname, e.lastname, e.firstname, SUM(s.salesamount) AS salesamount,
RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, p.productname ORDER BY SUM(s.salesamount) DESC ) as rank
FROM sales s
JOIN product p ON s.productkey = p.productkey
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
JOIN employee e ON e.employeekey = s.employeekey 
GROUP BY d.year, p.productname, e.lastname, e.firstname
)
SELECT year AS "Año", productname AS "Producto", lastname || '' || firstname AS "Empleado", salesamount AS "Ventas"
FROM ranking
WHERE rank = 1

question: Cuales son los países que componen el 50% de nuestras ventas
query:
WITH countries_sales AS (
SELECT ct.countryname, SUM(s.salesamount) AS salesamount
FROM sales s
JOIN customer c on c.customerkey = s.customerkey
JOIN city cy ON cy.citykey = c.citykey
JOIN state st ON st.statekey = cy.statekey
JOIN country ct ON ct.countrykey = st.countrykey
GROUP BY  ct.countryname
),
share AS (
SELECT countryname, salesamount, SUM(salesamount) OVER(ORDER BY salesamount DESC)/ SUM(salesamount) OVER() AS share,
salesamount / SUM(salesamount) OVER() AS sales_percent
FROM countries_sales
)
SELECT countryname AS "País", salesamount AS "Ventas", sales_percent * 100 AS "Porcentaje de ventas"
FROM share
WHERE share <= 0.5
evidence: SUM(salesamount) OVER(ORDER BY salesamount DESC)/ SUM(salesamount) OVER()

question: Quiero el total de las ventas y el promedio mensual de ventas por empleado y por año
query:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
SELECT e.lastname, e.firstname, d.year, d.monthnumber, SUM(s.salesamount :: numeric) AS salesamount
FROM sales s
JOIN employee e ON e.employeekey = s.employeekey
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
GROUP BY lastname, firstname, year, monthnumber
)
SELECT lastname || ' ' || firstname AS "Empleado", year AS "Año",
SUM(salesamount) AS "Ventas Totales", AVG(salesamount) AS "Ventas promedio mensuales"
FROM monthly_sales
GROUP BY lastname, firstname, year
ORDER BY lastname, firstname, year
evidence: GROUP BY lastname, firstname, year, monthnumber

question: Cuantas fueron las ventas mensuales y los descuentos aplicados por cada producto
query:
SELECT p.productname AS "Producto", d.year AS "Año", d.monthnumber AS "Mes",
SUM(s.salesamount) AS "Ventas", SUM( s.salesamount * s.discount) AS "Descuentos"
FROM sales s
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
JOIN product p ON p.productkey = s.productkey
GROUP BY p.productname, d.year, d.monthnumber
ORDER BY p.productname, d.year, d.monthnumber

question: Dame las ventas acumuladas mensuales por cada categoria de producto
query:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
SELECT c.categoryname, d.year, d.monthnumber, SUM(s.salesamount) AS salesamount
FROM sales s
JOIN product p ON p.productkey = s.productkey
JOIN category c ON c.categorykey = p.categorykey
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
GROUP BY categoryname, year, monthnumber
)
SELECT categoryname AS "Categoría de producto", year AS "Año", monthnumber AS "Mes", SUM(salesamount) OVER(PARTITION BY categoryname ORDER BY year, monthnumber) AS "Ventas mensuales acumuladas"
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY categoryname, year, monthnumber

question: Dame el promedio movil de las ultimas 3 ventas mensuales por categoria de producto
query:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
SELECT c.categoryname, d.year, d.monthnumber, SUM(s.salesamount :: numeric) AS salesamount
FROM sales s
JOIN product p ON p.productkey = s.productkey
JOIN category c ON c.categorykey = p.categorykey
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
GROUP BY categoryname, year, monthnumber
)
SELECT categoryname AS "Categoría de producto", year AS "Año", monthnumber AS "Mes", 
AVG(salesamount) OVER(
PARTITION BY categoryname 
ORDER BY year, monthnumber
ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Promedio movil últimos 3 meses"
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY categoryname, year, monthnumber
evidence: ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

question: Quiero que me compares las ventas totales de un empleado contra el total de las realizadas por el y todos sus subordinados en el año 2017
query:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
SELECT e.lastname, e.firstname, e.employeekey AS bosskey, e.employeekey AS subordinatekey
FROM employee e
UNION ALL
SELECT h.lastname, h.firstname, h.bosskey, e.employeekey AS subordinatekey
FROM employee e
JOIN hierarchy h ON e.supervisorkey = h.subordinatekey
),
employee_sales AS (
SELECT s.employeekey, SUM(s.salesamount) AS salesamount
FROM sales s
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
WHERE d.year = 2017
GROUP BY s.employeekey
)
SELECT h.lastname || ' ' || h.firstname AS "Empleado", es2.salesamount AS "Ventas propias", SUM(es.salesamount) "Ventas del equipo"
FROM employee_sales es
JOIN hierarchy h ON h.subordinatekey = es.employeekey
JOIN employee_sales es2 ON es2.employeekey = h.bosskey
GROUP BY h.lastname, h.firstname, es2.salesamount
evidence: JOIN hierarchy h ON h.subordinatekey = es.employeekey

question: Para cada mes quiero que me digas las ventas totales, la cantidad de ordenes emitidas y el ticket promedio
query:
WITH order_sales AS(
SELECT d.year, d.monthnumber, s.orderno, SUM(s.salesamount) AS salesamount
FROM sales s
JOIN date d ON s.orderdatekey = d.datekey
GROUP BY d.year, d.monthnumber, s.orderno
)
SELECT year AS "Año", monthnumber AS "Mes", SUM(salesamount) AS "Ventas totales",
COUNT(orderno) AS "Cantidad de órdenes", AVG(salesamount :: numeric) AS "Ticker promedio"
FROM order_sales
GROUP BY year, monthnumber
ORDER BY year, monthnumber

question: Dame por cada empleado el monto total vendido, el numero de clientes gestionados y el numero de ciudades y estados a los que fue asignado
query:
SELECT e.lastname || ' ' || e.firstname AS "Empleado", SUM(s.salesamount) AS "Ventas totales",
COUNT (DISTINCT s.customerkey) AS "Clientes gestionados", COUNT(DISTINCT c.citykey) AS "Ciudades asignadas",
COUNT( DISTINCT st.statekey) AS "Estados asignados"
FROM sales s
JOIN employee e ON e.employeekey = s.employeekey
JOIN territories t ON t.employeekey = s.employeekey
JOIN city c ON c.citykey = t.citykey
JOIN state st ON st.statekey = c.statekey

question: Quiero saber el tiempo de entrega de los pedidos y sus días de atraso por transportista y destino.
query:
SELECT DISTINCT orderno AS "Pedido", d2.date AS "Fecha estimada de entrega",
d2.date - d1.date AS "Días para la entrega", d3.date AS "Fecha de entrega",
d3.date - d2.date AS "Días de atraso", sh.companyname AS "Transportista",
ci.cityname AS "Ciudad", st.statename AS "Estado", co.countryname AS "País", con.continentname AS "Continente"
FROM sales s
JOIN date d1 ON d1.datekey = s.orderdatekey
JOIN date d2 ON d2.datekey = s.shippeddatekey
JOIN date d3 ON d3.datekey = s.duedatekey
JOIN shipper sh ON sh.shipperkey = s.shipperkey
JOIN customer c ON c.customerkey = s.customerkey
JOIN city ci ON ci.citykey = c.citykey
JOIN state st ON st.statekey = ci.statekey
JOIN country co ON co.countrykey = st.countrykey
JOIN continent con ON con.continentkey = co.continentkey

question: Cuantos son los días promedio de atraso y el costo total del flete por transportista
query:
WITH logistic AS (
SELECT DISTINCT s.orderno, s.freight, sh.companyname, d.date - d2.date AS "delay_days"
FROM sales s
JOIN shipper sh ON sh.shipperkey = s.shipperkey
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.duedatekey
JOIN date d2 ON d2.datekey = s.shippeddatekey
)
SELECT companyname AS "Transportista", SUM(freight) AS "Costo total del flete", AVG(delay_days) AS "Días promedio de atraso"
FROM logistic
GROUP BY  companyname

question: Quiero el ABC de los productos con sus categorías, donde A son el 80% de las ventas, B el 15% de las ventas y C el 5% restante
query:
WITH product_sales AS (
SELECT c.categoryname, p.productname, SUM(s.salesamount) as sales
FROM sales s
JOIN product p ON p.productkey = s.productkey
JOIN category c ON c.categorykey = p.categorykey
GROUP BY c.categoryname, p.productname
),
cum_percent_sales AS (
SELECT categoryname, productname, sales, SUM(sales) OVER(ORDER BY sales DESC) / SUM(sales) OVER() AS cum_percent
FROM product_sales
ORDER BY sales DESC
)
SELECT categoryname AS "Categoría de producto", productname AS "Producto", sales AS "Ventas totales", CASE WHEN cum_percent <= 0.8 THEN 'A'
                                              WHEN cum_percent <= 0.95 THEN 'B'
                                              ELSE 'C' END AS "Categoría ABC"
FROM cum_percent_sales
evidence: SUM(sales) OVER(ORDER BY sales DESC) / SUM(sales) OVER()

question: Quiero la variación mensual de las ventas por categoría de producto
query:
WITH categori_sales AS (
SELECT c.categoryname, d.year, d.monthnumber, SUM(s.salesamount) as sales
FROM sales s
JOIN date d ON d.datekey = s.orderdatekey
JOIN product p ON p.productkey = s.productkey
JOIN category c ON c.categorykey = p.categorykey
GROUP BY c.categoryname, d.year, d.monthnumber
ORDER BY c.categoryname, d.year, d.monthnumber
)
SELECT categoryname AS "Categoría de producto", year AS "Año", monthnumber AS "Mes", 
((sales / LAG(sales) OVER(PARTITION BY categoryname ORDER BY year, monthnumber)) - 1) * 100 AS "Variación porcentual"
FROM categori_sales
evidence: PARTITION BY categoryname ORDER BY year, monthnumber

question: Dame el top 10 de los clientes que mas compran seguido junto el total vendido a cada uno
query:
SELECT c.companyname AS "Cliente", COUNT( DISTINCT s.orderno) AS "Cant. de compras", SUM(s.salesamount) AS "Venta total"
FROM sales s
JOIN customer c ON c.customerkey = s.customerkey
GROUP BY c.companyname
ORDER BY "Cant. de compras" DESC
LIMIT 10
